# rust-stark-zkvm

> Experimental Rust STARK zkVM: custom ISA -> execution trace -> AIR -> Winterfell STARK proof -> independent verification.

## Implemented
- Custom .zkasm VM with ADD, SUB, MUL, JZ, JNZ, LOAD, and STORE
- Fixed register file
- Winterfell AIR, prover, and verifier
- CLI run/prove/verify/deploy/demo commands
- HTTP proving and verification service
- MCP prove/verify tools
- CI proof gates
- Local-chain task/reward demonstration

## Important limits
- Jumps are forward-only; loops are not implemented.
- Memory is a small fixed register file, not general-purpose memory.
- mock-echo is a stub backend.
- Recursion is documented research scope, not implemented.
- The local-chain demonstration is not a trustless on-chain STARK verifier.
